about: The Fractured Archive's lobby (raid step 14), map square 64,86 of the 241.4 cache: the four NPCs with options, as the Wiki's lobby list names them. Neither mejrs's NPC list nor the Wiki has their tiles yet, so every tile is guessed from the lobby's map, beside the loc each one tends, until a recording of the lobby shows them. The guards, druids and Alliance builders wait for that recording.

General Montoya (general_montoya), by the planning table at 4117,5545. Tile guessed
Record Keeper (tfa_record_keeper), by the Alliance records at 4135,5544. Tile guessed
Wizard apprentice (tfa_wizard_apprentice), among the Ascension rocks (4110 to 4117, 5532 to 5539), as the Wiki places him. Tile and wander guessed
